infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Field Ops Pro needs your location to track work hours, calculate mileage, and automatically detect when you arrive at job sites.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Field Ops Pro needs your location while you're working to track your position and calculate travel time.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Field Ops Pro needs background location access to continuously track your position during work hours, even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Field Ops Pro needs camera access to capture job site photos and completion documentation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Field Ops Pro needs photo library access to save and retrieve job site photos.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Field Ops Pro uses Face ID to securely authenticate you when clocking in and out.
